title: The Almost Playlist
author: R. M. Crane
blurb: Cyrus Amberdale, the new kid at a school built over something old, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
